messages:
incidents-bot: [AUTO-PAGER] P1 — API error spike detected: elevated 5xx rates on /v1/generate (hosted). Incident ID INC-2026-042. Auto-page to oncall. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-042

sarah: Ack — I'm oncall. Pulling metrics and recent deploys now. @james can you confirm if any infra changes landed in the last 30m?

james: I see a canary deploy for model-serving v3.2.1 at 17:12 UTC that included a quantization tweak. LB is showing increased 504/502s to the canary subset. Initiating rollback to v3.2.0 now.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started by james. Job ID: 8341. Target: canary -> v3.2.0.

mike: checking model-serving pod logs — getting KV cache mismatch errors and OOM-ish traces around decoder path. Suspect the quantization change altered mem layout for KV cache.

sarah: good call. If rollback doesn't clear it we'll scale pods and disable prefix caching for affected routes as a mitigation.

liz: CS heads up — any known customer-facing impact yet? I need to triage high-touch accounts.

emily-cs: preliminary: hosted-default customers and several small dedicated pools saw increased 5xx and latency. No data loss, but requests failed or timed out. I'll assemble impacted-customer list now (will share S3 link).

james: rollback complete — traffic moved off canary. Error rate dropped from ~12% to 0.9% over 6m. Monitoring closely.

sarah: confirming stab. Marking incident as mitigated in the channel. Updating status page to "Investigating -> Identified -> Mitigated" and setting a follow-up RCA.

incidents-bot: Status updated: INC-2026-042 moved to MITIGATED by sarah.

emily-cs: Drafting external customer follow-up. Sharing proposed short summary for review:```
Hi —

We experienced an elevated error rate on the Redwood hosted API earlier today (INC-2026-042). Impact: a subset of customers saw increased 5xx responses and timeouts between 17:12–17:48 UTC. No data was lost. We rolled back a canary deploy and mitigations reduced errors; service restored for affected traffic by ~17:48 UTC.

Root cause (preliminary): a quantization change in model-serving v3.2.1 caused incompatibility with KV cache memory layout for some instances, leading to request failures.

Next steps: full RCA and timeline will be published by EOD; we are rolling back the change from canary and adding additional tests in CI to validate KV cache compatibility for quantized models.

If you have questions or were impacted please reply or open a support ticket.
```

liz: that looks good. Can we add a line about entitlement to credits/SLAs? maybe: "If this impacted your SLA we will follow up with credits where applicable."

emily-cs: added. Also want to confirm exact timeline for the internal RCA timeline and who will own the customer email send.

dave: I can own the tech RCA writeup and timeline. I'll gather logs and perf traces and assemble a draft by EOD.

james: timeline note: canary deploy started 17:12 UTC, error spike noticeable at ~17:15 UTC, rollback initiated 17:28 UTC, traffic primarily stable by 17:48 UTC.

emily-cs: perfect — I'll include that timeline in the customer note. Sending to affected customers at 18:15 UTC (allowing time for final approvals). Who needs to sign off?

sarah: engineering sign-off from james + dave, and CS sign-off from liz. If we get thumbs within 20m, proceed.

james: thumbs. :+1:

dave: thumbs. I'll add one technical appendix to the RCA with log snippets and the reproducer steps.

emily-cs: copying the final customer-facing message here for quick review (short form):```
Subject: Incident update — Service restored (INC-2026-042)

Hello,

We experienced an elevated error rate affecting API requests to /v1/generate between 17:12–17:48 UTC. We rolled back a canary deploy and mitigations reduced errors; service was restored by 17:48 UTC.

Preliminary cause: incompatibility between a quantization tweak in model-serving v3.2.1 and the KV cache layout for certain instances. No customer data lost.

Next steps: full RCA + timeline will be posted by EOD. If you were impacted and would like a direct follow-up, reply to this message or open a support ticket.

Thanks for your patience — Emily (Customer Success)
```

liz: LGTM. small nit: add link to status page and support contact.

emily-cs: done.

sarah: reminder for on-call handoff: I'll include this incident in tomorrow morning's oncall notes and handoff to james for follow-up. @james you'll own any infra-side remediation tasks?

james: yup — I'll add a guard in the runtime that validates KV cache compatibility on startup and block canaries failing that check. Also will extend CI fuzzing for quantized models.

dave: action items I will track in the postmortem: 1) detailed timeline (owner: dave, due: EOD), 2) deploy gating change to ensure cache compatibility (owner: james, due: +3 days), 3) CS customer outreach and SLA credit handling (owner: emily-cs, due: +1 day).

emily-cs: sending the customer updates now and will post the final RCA to the /postmortems channel when dave publishes his writeup.

sarah: thanks team. Closing thread here — please ping if anything else crops up.

emails-bot: Customer update sent to 27 affected accounts by emily-cs at 18:13 UTC.
